state:
**Goal `tooling-overhaul`, Stage 10.** The cutover is on `main`. `main` stays frozen, and tag `pre-overhaul` is the rollback.

`bun nv playbook --triage <section>` is on disk (`tools/nv/cmd/playbook.ts:707`). Sections `divergences`, `splitting-a-file` and `running-things` are decided. `writing-a-test-case` has 405 of 536 bullets left to decide, and its alphabetical first 35 (up to `a-closure-is-an-object-…`) are decided. `writing-novis` and `tooling` (301 of 397) still owe too.

A bullet has two homes that are read: the fragment under `docs/agent/playbook/<section>/` and the record under `data/playbook/<section>/`. A batch changes both. `.agent-tmp/triage-splitting.ts <batch.json>` is the batch script. Its batch file is `{ "section", "delete": [ids], "keep": { id: "path:word" } }`, and `.agent-tmp/triage-test-1.json` is an example. The script checks that each `gone` condition stands before it writes anything, and refuses the whole batch if one does not. A `gone` word must not contain `]`, because the trailer parser stops at the first one. The report's `propose` word is often a poor anchor (a binary, a generic word): check it with `git grep -n -F`.

The report's `OWES A DECISION` / `DECIDED` flag is on the `==` header line. `awk '/^== /{p = /OWES A DECISION/} p'` pulls only the owed blocks, and `awk '/^== /{n++} n<=35'` over that takes one batch.

A language claim in a `writing-a-test-case` bullet is cheap to probe: a three-line `.nvs` under `.agent-tmp/` run with `target/debug/nvs.exe run`. Probes this session found `?bool` truth tests, `array<mixed>` casts, `++` and `+=` all working, so bullets saying otherwise were deleted.

The goal-only sweep is red on the four checks later stages own: Stage 9's `audit checks`, Stage 11's `audit ci` and `loop-stats --guard`, and Stage 12's `audit python`, plus Stage 10's trailer check until every section is triaged.
